 News › News News › Chennai school holiday today? IMD issues rain alert for Tamil Nadu; Check district-wise updates for … Chennai school holiday today? IMD issues rain alert for Tamil Nadu; Check district-wise updates for October 23
 Ashita Kashyap Published: Oct 23, 2026, 10:12 IST Updated: Oct 23, 2026, 10:12 IST Heavy rain affected Chennai and nearby areas, know updates Chennai school holiday update for October 23, 2026: Schools in Chennai are scheduled to function normally, according to the latest available reports. Although heavy rainfall has affected the city and nearby districts, no fresh school-closure order has been reported.
 However, The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has warned of continued rainfall across Tamil Nadu. Parents and students should check official school notices for any last-minute changes.
 Chennai school holiday today: Are schools closed on October 23?
 Students and parents in Chennai are looking for updates on school holidays as heavy rain continues to affect Tamil Nadu. However, schools in Chennai are scheduled to remain open on Friday, October 23, 2026, according to the latest report by a renowned media house.
 The report states that no fresh closure order has been announced for Chennai. Schools in neighbouring districts, including Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram and Chengalpattu, will function normally.
 The situation is different in some other parts of Tamil Nadu, where district administrations have announced holidays due to heavy rainfall. Therefore students should not assume that a holiday declared in another district also applies to Chennai.
 Parents are also advised to check messages and announcements from their children's schools and follow the instructions from the Chennai district administration before sending them to school.
 Why were schools closed in Chennai on October 21?
 Schools in Chennai and four other Tamil Nadu districts were closed on Wednesday, October 21, following heavy overnight rainfall.
 According to reports by renowned media houses , the holiday covered Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, Chengalpattu and Ranipet. 
 District Collectors announced the closures as a precautionary measure amid heavy showers and waterlogging in several areas.
 The rainfall affected roads and daily lives in parts of Chennai. Following it the authorities took precautionary steps to reduce the risks faced by students travelling to and from school.
 However, the October 21 holiday was a one-day closure. It did not automatically extend to October 22 or October 23. 
 A fresh instructions from the district administration are needed to confirm any additional holiday.
 IMD Weather alert: Will heavy rain affect Chennai schools?
 The India Meteorological Department has warned of continued rainfall across Tamil Nadu as the northeast monsoon becomes active. In its weather information published on October 23, the IMD forecast very heavy rainfall at isolated places in parts of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry over the coming days. The department has also warned of thunderstorms, lightning and strong winds in some areas.
 Chennai has experienced heavy showers during the current spell, waterlogging and poor road conditions can affect travel, particularly in low-lying areas.
 However, a weather alert does not automatically mean that schools will remain closed . The district administration must announce a holiday or the individual school must communicate a change in its schedule.
 Therefore, parents should monitor official weather updates and school notices for the latest information.
 Are schools in nearby Tamil Nadu districts closed today?
 The reported school status for Friday, October 23, is as follows:
 Chennai: Schools scheduled to function normally; no fresh closure order reported.
 Tiruvallur: Schools scheduled to function normally.
 Kancheepuram: Schools scheduled to function normally.
 Chengalpattu: Schools scheduled to function normally.
 Tiruvannamalai , Viluppuram and Kallakurichi: School closures have been reported amid rainfall.
 The situation may change if local authorities issue new instructions. Students should check the latest district-specific announcements rather than rely on earlier holiday reports.
 What should parents and students do?
 Parents should confirm their school's schedule before travelling, especially if their neighbourhood has experienced waterlogging or heavy rainfall.
 Students should also check whether examinations, practicals or other school activities are taking place as planned. 
 If a school announces online classes or a revised timetable, students should follow the instructions provided by the institution.
 For reliable updates, one can visit the ( https://mausam.imd.gov.in/chennai/ ) website for weather warnings and check notices issued by the district administration.
 In simple words, schools in Chennai are scheduled to remain open on October 23, 2026, according to the latest available reports. Since heavy rain may continue, parents should verify any last-minute changes directly with their schools.
